title: Access to Guns in the Heat of the Moment: More Restrictive Gun Laws Mitigate the Effect of Temperature on Violence
abstract: Gun violence is a major problem in the United States, and extensive prior work has shown that higher temperatures increase violent behavior. In this paper, we consider whether restricting the concealed carry of firearms mitigates or exacerbates the effect of temperature on violence. We use two identification strategies that exploit daily variation in temperature and variation in gun control policies between and within states. Our findings suggest that more prohibitive concealed carry laws attenuate the temperature-homicide relationship. Additional results suggest that restrictions primarily decrease the lethality of temperature-driven violent crimes, rather than their overall occurrence, but may be less effective at reducing access to guns in more urban areas.
abstract_zh: 枪支暴力是美国的一个重大问题，大量已有研究表明，较高的气温会增加暴力行为。本文考察限制隐蔽携枪是减轻还是加剧了气温对暴力的影响。我们采用两种识别策略，分别利用每日气温的变化，以及各州之间和各州内部枪支管控政策的差异。我们的研究结果表明，更严格的隐蔽携枪法律会减弱气温与凶杀案之间的关系。补充结果表明，这些限制主要降低了由气温驱动的暴力犯罪的致命程度，而非其总体发生率，但在城市地区，它们减少枪支获取的效果可能较弱。

title: The Census Environmental Impacts Frame
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Research in environmental economics often relies on aggregated place-based data, limiting our understanding of the interplay between economic activity and environmental conditions. To mitigate this, we introduce the Census Environmental Impacts Frame (EIF), a new microdata infrastructure linking individual-level socioeconomic data and residential histories with high-resolution estimates of environmental conditions for nearly all US residents over the past 2 decades. The EIF enables researchers to analyze the distribution of environmental conditions using individual-level rather than place-based data, track exposures over time, and assess their economic consequences in unprecedented detail. This article describes the EIF and summarizes opportunities for researchers.
abstract_zh: 环境经济学研究常依赖按地点汇总的数据，这限制了我们理解经济活动与环境状况之间相互作用的能力。为缓解这一问题，我们推出了人口普查环境影响框架（Census Environmental Impacts Frame，EIF），这是一个新的微观数据基础设施，将个人层面的社会经济数据和居住历史，与过去20年间美国几乎所有居民所处环境状况的高分辨率估计相链接。EIF使研究人员能够利用个人层面而非地点层面的数据来分析环境状况的分布，追踪暴露随时间的变化，并以前所未有的细节评估其经济后果。本文介绍了EIF，并概述了其为研究者带来的机会。

title: The Public-Use Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article introduces the Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame (Gridded EIF), a novel public-use data set derived from the US Census Bureau’s confidential Environmental Impacts Frame (EIF) microdata infrastructure. The EIF combines comprehensive administrative records and survey data on the US population with high-resolution geospatial information on environmental conditions. Although access to the EIF is restricted due to the confidential nature of the underlying data, the Gridded EIF offers a broader research community the opportunity to glean insights from the data and preserve confidentiality. We describe the data and privacy-protection methods and offer guidance on appropriate usage, presenting practical applications.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了网格化环境影响框架（Gridded EIF），这是一个新颖的公共使用数据集，源自美国人口普查局保密的环境影响框架（EIF）微观数据基础设施。EIF将关于美国人口的全面行政记录和调查数据，与环境状况的高分辨率地理空间信息相结合。尽管由于底层数据的保密性质，EIF的访问受到限制，但网格化EIF为更广泛的研究界提供了从数据中获得洞见的机会，同时又能保护保密性。我们描述了数据及隐私保护方法，提供了恰当使用的指导，并展示了若干实际应用。

title: Environmental Citizen Complaints
The Intergenerational Effects of Early-Life Pollution Exposure
Transitional Costs and the Decline of Coal: Worker-Level Evidence
Air Pollution and Economic Opportunity in the United States
Heat Disparities in the United States: An Individual-Level Analysis
Income, Wealth, and Environmental Inequality in the United States
abstract: This paper explores the relationships between air pollution, income, and wealth by combining data from U.S. tax returns between 1979–2016, various measures of air pollution, and sociodemographic information from linked survey and administrative data. In the first year of our data, the relationship between income and ambient pollution levels nationally is approximately zero. However, at every single percentile of the national income distribution, Black individuals are exposed to, on average, higher levels of air pollution than White individuals. By 2016, the relationship between income and air pollution had steepened, primarily for Black individuals, driven by changes in where rich and poor Black individuals live. We utilize quasi-random shocks to income to examine the causal effect of changes in income and wealth on pollution exposure over a five year horizon, finding that these income–pollution elasticities map closely to the values implied by our descriptive patterns. We calculate that Black-White differences in income can explain ∼10 percent of the observed racial gap in air pollution exposure in 2016.
abstract_zh: 本文通过结合1979年至2016年美国纳税申报数据、多种空气污染衡量指标，以及关联的调查与行政数据中的社会人口学信息，探讨了空气污染、收入与财富之间的关系。在数据的第一年，全国范围内收入与环境污染水平之间的关系约为零。然而，在全国收入分布的每一个百分位上，黑人个体平均所暴露的空气污染水平都高于白人个体。到2016年，收入与空气污染之间的关系变得更加陡峭，这主要发生在黑人群体中，其驱动因素是富裕和贫穷黑人居住地点的变化。我们利用收入的准随机冲击，考察了收入和财富变化在五年期内对污染暴露的因果效应，发现这些收入—污染弹性与我们描述性规律所隐含的数值非常接近。我们测算出，2016年黑人与白人之间的收入差距，可以解释观察到的空气污染暴露种族差距中约10%。

title: Is the Electricity Sector a Weak Link in Development?
abstract: This paper evaluates the case that the electricity sector is a weak link in the development of low-income countries. To do so, we build a database of electricity inputs and outputs for 100 countries of all income levels and use it to measure electricity-sector total-factor productivity (TFP). We document that electricity TFP varies considerably less across low- and high-income countries than aggregate TFP. We then use the data to parameterize a multi-sector growth model in which electricity is a strong complement to other inputs in production and the electricity sector faces distortions in its own input and output markets. Quantitatively, the model predicts only modest long-run GDP gains from raising electricity TFP or removing distortions. These predictions are inconsistent with the view that electricity is a weak link. We show that parameterizations making electricity a weak link would require the sector to be counterfactually large or unproductive.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一种观点，即电力部门是低收入国家发展中的薄弱环节。为此，我们构建了涵盖100个各收入水平国家的电力投入产出数据库，并利用其测算电力部门的全要素生产率（TFP）。我们发现，与总体TFP相比，低收入国家与高收入国家之间的电力TFP差异明显更小。随后，我们利用这些数据对一个多部门增长模型进行参数化，其中电力是生产中其他投入的强互补品，且电力部门自身的投入和产出市场存在扭曲。定量分析显示，提高电力TFP或消除扭曲，只能带来适度的长期GDP增长。这些预测与“电力是薄弱环节”的观点不一致。我们表明，要使电力成为薄弱环节的参数设定，将要求该部门在反事实意义上规模过大或生产率过低。

title: Nice Work if You Can Get It? The Distribution of Employment and Earnings During the Early Years of the Clean Energy Transition
The Causes and Consequences of Urban Heat Islands
The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims
abstract: The economic burden of natural disasters is shaped by who is exposed, who experiences losses, how those losses alter individual economic trajectories, and how affected communities evolve in the aftermath. We link property-level damage data from over 100 U.S. wildfires to administrative tax and Census data to understand individual-level relationships between disaster damage and economic outcomes. Residents of burned areas are wealthier than the U.S. population on average, but within these wildfire perimeters the likelihood that a home burns is negatively correlated with pre-fire income. Home destruction imposes costs beyond rebuilding the property: occupants of destroyed homes experience lower income for three years post-fire, producing cumulative income losses equal to 26 percent of pre-fire annual income. We do not detect income or employment effects for residents without direct property damage. Community recovery is slow and accompanied by changes in composition. Four years after a fire, half of destroyed addresses remain unoccupied and reoccupied addresses house residents with substantially higher incomes than before.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害的经济负担，取决于谁暴露于灾害之中、谁遭受损失、这些损失如何改变个人的经济轨迹，以及受影响社区在灾后如何演变。我们将来自100多场美国野火的房产层面损毁数据与行政税收和人口普查数据相连接，以理解灾害损毁与经济结果之间的个体层面关系。烧毁地区的居民平均而言比美国总体人口更富裕，但在这些野火边界之内，房屋被烧毁的可能性与火灾发生前的收入呈负相关。房屋被毁所带来的成本不仅限于重建房产：房屋被毁居民在火灾后三年内收入下降，累计收入损失相当于火灾前年收入的26%。对于没有直接房产损失的居民，我们未发现收入或就业效应。社区恢复缓慢，并伴随着构成的变化。火灾发生四年后，一半被毁地址仍无人居住，而重新入住的地址中，居民的收入明显高于此前。

title: The Global Effects of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanisms
abstract: Climate change poses a collective action problem: countries bear the costs of carbon regulation, while benefits are shared globally. Carbon border adjustment mechanisms (CBAMs) aim to realign incentives by extending domestic carbon pricing to imports. Using plant-level data for aluminum and steel, which account for 11% of global CO2 emissions, we document that emissions intensity is income-neutral and uncorrelated with production costs. Carbon pricing introduces a new margin of green comparative advantage. With a quantitative trade model, we show that CBAMs can boost domestic competitiveness, reduce emissions leakage, and facilitate collective climate action, while largely avoiding disproportionate burdens on lower-income countries. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 气候变化带来集体行动问题：各国承担碳监管的成本，而收益则由全球共享。碳边境调节机制（CBAM）旨在通过将国内碳定价延伸至进口产品，重新调整激励。利用铝和钢铁的工厂层面数据——这两个行业占全球CO2排放的11%——我们发现，排放强度与收入水平无关，也与生产成本不相关。碳定价引入了绿色比较优势的新维度。借助一个定量贸易模型，我们表明，碳边境调节机制可以提升国内竞争力，减少排放泄漏，并促进集体气候行动，同时在很大程度上避免对低收入国家造成不成比例的负担。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Do Carbon Offsets Offset Carbon?
abstract: We develop and implement a new method for identifying wasted subsidies, and use it to provide systematic evidence on the misallocation of carbon offsets in the Clean Development Mechanism—the world’s largest carbon offset program. Using newly constructed data on the locations and characteristics of 1,350 wind farms in India—a context where it was believed, ex ante, that the Clean Development Mechanism could significantly increase development above baseline projections—we estimate that at least 52% of approved carbon offsets were allocated to projects that would very likely have been built anyway. In addition to wasting scarce resources, we estimate that the sale of these offsets to regulated polluters has substantially increased global carbon dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们开发并实施了一种识别无效补贴的新方法，并利用它系统地提供了清洁发展机制（Clean Development Mechanism）中碳抵消额度错配的证据——该机制是全球最大的碳抵消计划。利用新构建的印度1,350座风电场的位置和特征数据——在这一情境下，事前普遍认为清洁发展机制可以显著促进超出基线预测的发展——我们估计，至少52%的已批准碳抵消额度被分配给了很可能无论如何都会建成的项目。除了浪费稀缺资源之外，我们估计，将这些抵消额度出售给受监管的污染者，已大幅增加了全球二氧化碳排放。

title: Does Pricing Carbon Mitigate Climate Change? Firm-Level Evidence from the European Union Emissions Trading Scheme
abstract: In theory, market-based regulatory instruments correct market failures at least cost. However, evidence on their efficacy remains scarce. Using administrative data, we estimate that, on average, the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS)—the world’s first and largest market-based climate policy—induced regulated manufacturing firms to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by 14–16% with no detectable contractions in economic activity. We find no evidence of outsourcing to unregulated firms or markets; instead, firms made targeted investments, reducing the emissions intensity of production. These results indicate that the EU ETS induced global emissions reductions, a necessary and sufficient condition for mitigating climate change. We show that the absence of any negative economic effects can be rationalized in a model where pricing the externality induces firms to make fixed-cost investments in energy-saving capital that reduce marginal variable costs.
abstract_zh: 从理论上讲，基于市场的监管工具能以最低成本纠正市场失灵。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然稀缺。利用行政数据，我们估计，平均而言，欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）——全球首个也是规模最大的基于市场的气候政策——促使受监管的制造业企业减少了14–16%的二氧化碳排放，且未发现经济活动出现明显收缩。我们没有发现向未受监管企业或市场外包的证据；相反，企业进行了有针对性的投资，降低了生产的排放强度。这些结果表明，EU ETS促成了全球排放的减少，而这正是减缓气候变化的一个必要且充分的条件。我们表明，在一个模型中可以解释为何不存在任何负面经济效应：对外部性定价会促使企业进行固定成本投资于节能资本，从而降低边际可变成本。

title: Microdata and Natural Capital Valuation
venue: Book chapter in Measuring and Accounting for Environmental Public Goods

title: The Changing Nature of Pollution, Income, and Environmental Inequality in the United States
abstract: This paper uses administrative tax records linked to Census demographic data and high-resolution measures of fine small particulate (PM2.5) exposure to study the evolution of the Black-White pollution exposure gap over the past 40 years. In doing so, we focus on the various ways in which income may have contributed to these changes using a statistical decomposition. We decompose the overall change in the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap into (1) components that stem from rank-preserving compression in the overall pollution distribution and (2) changes that stem from a reordering of Black and White households within the pollution distribution. We find a significant narrowing of the Black-White PM2.5 exposure gap over this time period that is overwhelmingly driven by rank-preserving changes rather than positional changes. However, the relative positions of Black and White households at the upper end of the pollution distribution have meaningfully shifted in the most recent years.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与人口普查人口统计数据相关联的行政税收记录，以及细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露的高分辨率测量数据，研究了过去40年间黑人与白人污染暴露差距的演变。在此过程中，我们借助统计分解方法，聚焦于收入可能促成这些变化的各种途径。我们将黑人与白人之间PM2.5暴露差距的总体变化，分解为：（1）源于整体污染分布中保持秩次的压缩的成分；以及（2）源于黑人与白人家庭在污染分布中位置重新排序的变化。我们发现，在这一时期，黑人与白人之间的PM2.5暴露差距显著缩小，而这一缩小绝大多数由保持秩次的变化所驱动，而非位置变化。然而，在近年来，黑人与白人家庭在污染分布高端的相对位置发生了实质性变化。

title: Blame it on the Rain: Rainfall Variability, Consumption Smoothing, and Subjective Well-Being in Rural Ethiopia
Rainfall Variability, Child Labor, and Human Capital Accumulation in Rural Ethiopia
Temperature, Labor Reallocation, and Industrial Production: Evidence from India
abstract: To what degree can labor reallocation mitigate the economic consequences of weather-driven agricultural productivity shocks? I estimate that temperature-driven reductions in the demand for agricultural labor in India are associated with increases in nonagricultural employment. This suggests that the ability of nonagricultural sectors to absorb workers may play a key role in attenuating the economic consequences of agricultural productivity shocks. Exploiting firm-level variation in the propensity to absorb workers, I estimate relative expansions in manufacturing output in more flexible labor markets. Estimates suggest that, in the absence of labor reallocation, local economic losses could be up to 69 percent higher. (JEL J23, J43, L60, O13, O14, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 劳动力再配置在多大程度上能够缓解天气驱动的农业生产率冲击所带来的经济后果？我估计，在印度，由气温驱动的农业劳动需求减少，与非农就业增加相关。这表明，非农部门吸纳劳动力的能力可能在缓解农业生产率冲击的经济后果方面发挥关键作用。利用企业层面在吸纳劳动力倾向上的差异，我估计在劳动力市场更具灵活性的地区，制造业产出相对扩张。估计结果表明，若不存在劳动力再配置，当地的经济损失可能高出多达69%。（JEL J23, J43, L60, O13, O14, Q54, Q56）

title: Why are Pollution Damages Lower in Developed Countries? Insights from High-Income, High-Particulate Matter Hong Kong
abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that marginal damages from particulate matter pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are highly polluted. Using administrative data on the universe of births and deaths, we explore birthweight and mortality effects of gestational particulate matter exposure in high-pollution yet high-income Hong Kong. The marginal effects of particulates on birthweight are large but we fail to detect an effect on neonatal mortality. We interpret our stark mortality results in a comparative analysis of pollution-mortality relationships across studies. We provide early evidence that marginal mortality damages from pollution are high in less-developed countries because they are less developed, not because they are more polluted.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，发展中国家颗粒物污染的边际损害较高，是因为这些国家污染严重。利用覆盖全部出生与死亡人口的行政数据，我们在污染严重但属于高收入地区的香港考察了孕期颗粒物暴露对出生体重和死亡率的影响。颗粒物对出生体重的边际效应较大，但我们未能检测到其对新生儿死亡率的影响。我们在对各研究中污染与死亡率关系进行比较分析的基础上，解释了我们这一鲜明的死亡率结果。我们提供了初步证据，表明发展中国家污染的边际死亡损害较高，是因为它们发展程度较低，而并非因为它们污染更为严重。

What is the Meaning of (Statistical) Life? Benefit-Cost Analysis in the Time of COVID-19
